Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on 4 rows.

Fields.Name: Unknown Extra Site ID
Fields.Description: When this row applies and the value is not -1, it is added to a list of IDs the site lottery uses for the extra sites. Retail: 100, 200 and 300 on the Mountaintop, Crater and Rotted Woods rows. What the IDs select is not established.

Fields.Name: Force an Extra Major Site
Fields.Description: Set: when this row applies, the pattern gets at least one extra major site even if MapPatternSet's weighted draw gives none. Retail: set on the Mountaintop, Crater and Rotted Woods rows.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Unknown Value
Fields.Description: When this row applies and the value is not -1, it is passed on to the site lottery. Its effect is not established. Retail: 300 on one personal-scenario row, -1 elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Modifier 3
Fields.Description: A third modifier condition, read with Modifier 1 and 2. Retail: 14 (Map - Great Hollow) on seven personal-scenario rows.
